title: Issued API key
description: The JSON object POST /keys returns when Content-Type is application/json on umbra serve --public. The key is shown only in this response. The server stores a hash of it, the email, the optional name, organization and intended use, created_at, a revoked flag, and the UTC day the key was last used. It does not store the secret or an address. A browser form post returns HTML instead of this document. Stable within a minor version.

examples.message: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered.

key.description: The secret. Shown once. The server stores a hash, not this value.

email.description: The contact email, stripped and lowercased.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the key was created.
